quests.canDoWhy: Earn the jarl's trust by helping the people of Winterhold, then the jarl names you thane.

needs.what: Help the people of Winterhold (3 favours, counted in Making Friends and Influencing People)

starts.who: The Jarl of Winterhold (Korir or Kraldar)
starts.where: Stonecold Fortress (the jarl's longhouse) in Winterhold
starts.how: The quest is set off when you enter Winterhold (the records don't show what else that start checks); once you have helped enough people of the hold, the jarl offers the title.

rewards.what: The title of Thane of Winterhold
Gold (a large gold reward plus a set sum)
A piece of armor from the favour reward list
Blade of Winterhold (likely)

people.name: Korir
people.role: Jarl of Winterhold at the start of the game

people.name: Kraldar
people.role: jarl if the hold changes hands in the war

unsure.why: The records don't name a giver line for this quest; the jarl is the giver slot, filled when it runs.
The journal counts favours for this hold (3 needed) in Making Friends and Influencing People, but the link between that count and the jarl's offer isn't decoded in these files.
Unlike the other holds, this quest has no housecarl slot in the records, so no housecarl is listed.
The Blade of Winterhold comes as a sword and a greatsword; the files don't show which one the quest's hold-weapon slot, added by a mod in the list, gives you.
The gold, the gold reward list and the armor reward list are properties of the quest's own script; the amounts and the pieces aren't in these files.
